learnings.question: Which statistical concept or rule of thumb served as the primary motivation for investigating whether the top 20 words account for 80% of the text in the Quran?
learnings.learning: The investigation was motivated by testing the Pareto Principle (the 80/20 rule) to see if learning the top 20 most repeated words would cover 80% of the text in the Quran.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Islamic thought, which concept refers to the actual unfolding of events in one's life that can be altered through sincere actions and supplication?
learnings.learning: While individuals can alter their Qada’ (the actual occurrence of events) through sincere actions and supplication (Dua), any resulting change has always been known to Allah and is already part of His eternal plan (Qadr).
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Within the PCIe L1 power management substates, which specific substate achieves the maximum power savings at the cost of the longest delay to resume activity?
learnings.learning: Within PCIe L1 power management substates, achieving maximum power savings in L1.2 comes with the trade-off of introducing the longest wake-up delay before resuming full operation.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what is explicitly identified in Quran 51:56 as the foundational purpose for creating jinn and mankind?
options: To accumulate knowledge and material wealth
To govern and conquer earthly kingdoms
To experience worldly pleasures and diversions
learnings.learning: In Islamic belief, the foundational motivation behind the creation of jinn and mankind is defined in Quran 51:56 as being solely to worship Allah.

learnings.question: Which Scrum artifact is specifically used to visualize the progress of a Sprint and display the remaining work to track if the team is on schedule?
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Burndown Chart is the primary artifact designed to visualize Sprint progress and display remaining work to ensure the team stays on schedule.
